# Ultra Forge

> Universal skill pack + working template for building ultra-premium websites, web apps, Android APKs, desktop software,
> real-time 3D scenes and animations at "Ultra Level 1000", from design to deploy. AI assistants: read START_HERE.md first.

## Start
- [START_HERE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/START_HERE.md): install + build instructions for any AI
- [MASTER_PROMPT.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/MASTER_PROMPT.md): all 22 skills in one file (for chat AIs)
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/AGENTS.md): agent contract and repo map

## Template (complete working site — output these files, edited)
- [site/config.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/config.js): everything the user customises
- [site/index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/index.html)
- [site/css/style.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/css/style.css)
- [site/js/engine.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/js/engine.js): WebGL2 engine with 6 scenes
- [site/js/main.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/js/main.js)
- [site/sw.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/sw.js) · [site/manifest.webmanifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/site/manifest.webmanifest)

## Library
- [library/palettes.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/library/palettes.json): 40 tested palettes
- [library/styles.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/library/styles.md): 30 art directions
- [library/levels.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forpc1428-eng/ultra-forge/main/library/levels.json): Ultra Levels 1–1000
